title: European supermarket refrigeration cyber incidents — November 2026 wave
summary: Supermarket refrigeration systems in multiple European countries were reportedly accessed or disrupted, with some units' temperatures raised and perishable stock removed or discarded. Public reporting describes the event as a suspected cyberattack. The precise intrusion method and whether all affected countries were part of one campaign remain unconfirmed.
impact: Some affected refrigeration units reportedly reached approximately 50°C.
Retailers removed or discarded affected chilled and frozen products as a precaution.
The full number of affected stores and the relationship between national incidents were not established in the cited reporting.
